entities.name: Elizah
entities.description: Ethan's alter ego and defense mechanism born from trauma; he possesses violent wind powers and acts with extreme brutality against oppressors.
entities.quote: Elizah directly went for stitch and he beaten him brutally..didn't kill him.where elizah was almost killing him.

entities.name: Vanguard
entities.description: A soldier experimented upon by DEW who shares the same traumatic history of torture as Ethan.
entities.quote: When Ethan was captured, you said he was in one cell and Vanguard (Rifat) was being experimented in the next room.

entities.name: Covenant Leader
entities.description: A cold, formal man who considers his subordinates disposable and personally executes Stitch.
entities.quote: he is basically the leader of covenant and now we see a scene where we see vanguard was watching all these.and then walk aways.
